title: Fast PAC Global Optimization via Restarted Langevin: Exploration, Exploitation, and Degenerate Cooling
abstract: arXiv:2609.06196v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the computational effort required for global optimization of a smooth, possibly nonconvex objective $\Gamma:\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}$. An algorithm satisfies the $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-PAC performance requirement if its output $\widehat X$ obeys $\mathbb{P}\{\Gamma(\widehat X)-\Gamma^\star>\varepsilon\}\leq\delta$. Algorithm design and analysis are in continuous time. We compare classical simulated annealing and fixed-temperature Langevin diffusion with two approaches introduced and analyzed here: parallel-restart Langevin and a Langevin--gradient scheme using stochastic dynamics for global exploration and gradient flow for local exploitation.   Let $L=\log(1/\delta)$ and let $E_*$ denote the dominant energy barrier. At logarithmic precision in the low-temperature regime, the first two approaches require simulation time exponential in $L/\varepsilon$. translated_title: 基于重启朗之万动力学的快速PAC全局优化：探索、开发与退化冷却
translated_abstract: 我们研究光滑（可能非凸）目标函数 $\Gamma:\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}$ 的全局优化所需的计算量。如果一个算法的输出 $\widehat X$ 满足 $\mathbb{P}\{\Gamma(\widehat X)-\Gamma^\star>\varepsilon\}\leq\delta$，则称该算法满足 $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-PAC 性能要求。算法设计与分析均在连续时间框架下进行。我们将经典的模拟退火和固定温度朗之万扩散与本文引入并分析的两种新方法进行比较：并行重启朗之万方法，以及一种朗之万-梯度混合方案，该方案使用随机动力学进行全局探索，使用梯度流进行局部开发。设 $L=\log(1/\delta)$，$E_*$ 表示主导能垒。在低温区域的对数精度下，前两种方法需要与 $L/\varepsilon$ 呈指数关系的模拟时间。对于并行固定温度朗之万，适当数量的独立……
tldr: 本文提出并行重启朗之万与朗之万-梯度混合两种新算法，通过随机动力学实现全局探索、梯度流实现局部开发，为光滑非凸函数的全局优化提供了快速的PAC性能保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces two novel algorithms—parallel-restart Langevin and a Langevin-gradient hybrid scheme—that use stochastic dynamics for global exploration and gradient flow for local exploitation, achieving fast PAC guarantees for global optimization of smooth, possibly nonconvex objectives.
